title: Policy Document Understander — 政策文件理解器
description: Implement structured extraction from Chinese regulatory documents (PBOC, CSRC, State Council). The understander MUST identify issuing body, extract effective date, map policy changes to affected sectors, and output PolicyResult frozen dataclass. Depends on F-041 NER Engine for entity recognition and F-039 Sentiment Classifier for sentiment impact scoring.

criteria: PolicyResult frozen dataclass with 6 fields: [issuing_body, document_type, effective_date, key_changes, affected_sectors, sentiment_impact]
Sector mapping for 8+ sectors: [banking, insurance, securities, real_estate, technology, healthcare, energy, consumer]
12+ unit tests pass: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_policy_understander.py -p no:asyncio -q (exit code 0)
All frozen dataclasses use frozen=True, slots=True pattern
convergence.definition_of_done: Policy understander extracts issuing body, effective date, key changes, and sector impact from regulatory documents
